source_review.basis: Direct review of the benchmark PDF; primary gold uses only explicitly stated focal values with explicit concentration, time and temperature associations.

scored_numeric_observations.evidence_snippet: At 500 ppm ETO and 5 h immersion, the text reports a corrosion rate of 1.15 mm/y at 303 K.
At the same concentration and immersion time, inhibition efficiency was 98.4% at 303 K.

concentration_sweep.reason_not_primary_gold: The prose lists these concentration-dependent values while discussing Figure 2 across multiple immersion times, without a uniquely explicit time association for each listed pair.

mass_loss.reason: The paper defines and uses weight loss to calculate corrosion rate, but no direct focal numeric mass-loss value with the required full association was selected for gold.

source_conflicts_or_cautions: The paper separately reports 0.97 mm/year at 500 ppm in a concentration-sweep paragraph and 1.15 mm/y at 500 ppm, 5 h, 303 K in the temperature-series paragraph. These are not silently reconciled. The scored value is the one with explicit concentration, time and temperature association.
